parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS sid, GREATEST(COALESCE($2::int, 40), 1) AS win
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT m.id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.id DESC) AS rn_desc,
         m.message AS msg
  FROM public.memory m, params p
  WHERE m.session_id = p.sid
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT o.id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.id ASC) AS rn,
         COALESCE(o.msg->>'type', o.msg->>'role', o.msg->'kwargs'->>'type', '') AS msg_type,
         o.msg
  FROM ordered o, params p
  WHERE o.rn_desc <= p.win
),
orphans AS (
  SELECT w.id, w.rn
  FROM windowed w
  WHERE lower(w.msg_type) IN ('tool', 'toolmessage')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM windowed a
      WHERE a.rn < w.rn
        AND lower(COALESCE(a.msg->>'type', a.msg->>'role', a.msg->'kwargs'->>'type', '')) IN ('ai', 'aimessage')
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
            CASE 
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.msg->'kwargs'->'tool_calls') = 'array' THEN a.msg->'kwargs'->'tool_calls'
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.msg->'data'->'tool_calls') = 'array' THEN a.msg->'data'->'tool_calls'
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.msg->'tool_calls') = 'array' THEN a.msg->'tool_calls'
              WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.msg->'kwargs'->'additional_kwargs'->'tool_calls') = 'array' THEN a.msg->'kwargs'->'additional_kwargs'->'tool_calls'
              ELSE '[]'::jsonb 
            END
          ) tc
          WHERE tc->>'id' = COALESCE(
            w.msg->>'tool_call_id', 
            w.msg->'kwargs'->>'tool_call_id',
            w.msg->'data'->>'tool_call_id',
            ''
          )
        )
    )
),
deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM public.memory m
  USING orphans o
  WHERE m.id = o.id
  RETURNING m.id
)
SELECT (SELECT sid FROM params) AS session_id, COUNT(*)::int AS rows_deleted FROM deleted;
